name: Algolia Startup Program
free_limit: One-time $10,000 in Algolia search and discovery credits for eligible approved startups, valid for 12 months from approval (not recurring)
watch_out: Application and approval required. Algolia's program section says startups under 7 years old with under $15M raised qualify, but its FAQ says under 3 years and under $5M; confirm eligibility directly. New customers and existing Free users may apply; paying customers and prior startup coupon users are excluded. Unused credits expire after 12 months and exhausting them early moves usage to Pay as you go. Payment-card requirement and specific commercial-use terms for these credits are not explicitly confirmed on the program page.
